items.title: Joseph Rene Interview, 1960-09-08
items.q: You see Jungle Casualty? Old man Humphrey... That's Willie Humphrey, the old man.

ctx.x: So what about the clarinet players? Did they ever have two clarinet players to have a little cutting content? No, no, no.

They always have one clarinet. We'd have saxophone and things like that. You see Jungle Casualty? Old man Humphrey, and a couple of more. It was one of the best street parade clarinet players you've ever seen. That's Willie Humphrey, the old man.
